description: This file implements timer functions for the NRF_TIMER0 hardware timer on an ARM Cortex-M0 platform within the Zephyr RTOS, including timer initialization, interrupt handling, and clock management.

methods.name: counter_sub
methods.description: Subtracts two timer counter values with wrap-around handling.

methods.name: get_comparator
methods.description: Gets the current compare register value.

methods.name: counter
methods.description: Triggers a capture task and returns the current timer count.

methods.name: prevent_false_prev_evt
methods.description: Prevents false previous compare events by reconfiguring the compare register.

methods.name: handle_next_tick_case
methods.description: Handles setting the timer for the next tick when the counter is close to overflow.

methods.name: set_absolute_ticks
methods.description: Sets an absolute timer alarm, handling late setting and +1 tick cases.

methods.name: set_protected_absolute_ticks
methods.description: Sets an absolute timer alarm in a lockless manner, disabling and enabling interrupts.

methods.name: timer0_nrf_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for NRF_TIMER0, updates system clock and handles timer events.

methods.name: sys_clock_set_timeout
methods.description: Configures the system clock timeout based on ticks.

methods.name: sys_clock_elapsed
methods.description: Returns the number of elapsed ticks since last count.

methods.name: sys_clock_cycle_get_32
methods.description: Returns the current cycle count as a 32-bit value.

methods.name: sys_clock_driver_init
methods.description: Initializes the system clock driver, configures timer hardware, and sets up interrupts.
